body:
# Ranktab
RankTab is a ranking plugin that makes the server tab look more beautiful and professional, ideal for playing with friends.

Key features

Create custom ranks

Define ranks for players.

Change the color of the ranks.

Lists all registered ranks.

## Remove ranks

Displays the player's rank automatically in the chat and tab.

Update the tab for all online players.

Supports emojis in the tab title.

Allows text in multiple languages.

Controls the tab's appearance with a wave effect and chosen colors.

## Why use
It makes the server look more appealing.

Improves the gaming experience with friends.

It makes the tab more organized and personalized.

It makes it easier to quickly identify player ranks.

## Available commands
/setrank <player> <rankid>

/createrank <name>

/colorrank <rankid> <color>

/listranks

/removerank <rankid>

## config.yml settings
tab-title: tab title with emojis or Unicode

tab-color: title color when the wave is off

tab-wave-enabled: turn the wave effect on/off

tab-wave-style: rainbow or solid

tab-wave-colors: colors used in the rainbow effect

tab-show-players: show online players

tab-mostrar-ping: show ping in the footer
